verdict.rationale: The docs describe a skill creator that interviews the user about what a skill does, when it triggers, and whether it needs scripts (docs-7), plus a recorder that drafts a reusable skill from a demonstration (docs-16). For packaging, the built-in `@plugin-creator` scaffolds the plugin manifest and a local marketplace entry, and skills can be packaged as plugins for others (docs-10, docs-15, docs-47). A community user independently reports building proprietary skills with the skill-creator skill (comm-1). Missing for 10: documented support for iteratively improving or evaluating existing skills, and explicit first-party naming and detail of the skill-creator as a shipped built-in.
